[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Hark'r''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Noehon]] who served [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] as a [[Supply Master/Legends|Supply Master]] aboard ''[[Home]]''.

==Biography==
Hark'r was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Noehon]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who happened to pass close to ''[[Home]]'', a [[Tsukkian water freighter]] used by [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] as their headquarters and was promptly incarcerated. Afraid that Hark'r would sell information regarding the ship to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the leader of the Roughnecks, [[Lens Reekeene]], gave Hark'r a choice. The first option was that he could spend the duration of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on a primitive [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traffic or access to communications equipment. The second option was that he could spend the war working aboard ''Home''. The Noehon chose the latter option, reasoning that his chances for escape were better aboard the Roughnecks ship.<ref name="CP" />

Hark'r's natural aptitude for organization and management led Reekeene to assign him to oversee the commissary and supply department for the Roughnecks. Reekeene did not trust him, and kept a close eye on him. Hark'r, for his part, was terrified of Reekeene, and constantly attempted to bribe new Roughneck recruits to smuggle him off the ship.<ref name="CP" />

==Personality and traits==
Considered to be pudgy for a Noehon, Hark'r had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and four arms. He spoke perfect [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] with a clipped accent similar to those living in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. He used precise pronunciation and used insincere phrases such as "my dear fellows," "old chap," and "dear boy."<ref name="CC">''[[Classic Campaigns]]''</ref>
